title: Output complementation along a run
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state oracle Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $x$ be an input bit string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For every natural number $t$, running the machine with each transition’s output bit complemented for $t$ steps from the configuration whose existing output bits have all been complemented gives exactly the configuration obtained by first running $M$ with oracle $O$ for $t$ steps and then complementing every output bit.
